title: Marketing Cloud Winter '27 Release: What You Need to Know
summary: Salesforce's Winter '27 Marketing Cloud release includes more than 60 changes. Most headline features become generally available in October 2026: Account Discovery Agent, Personalized Paths in Flow, and Headless Marketing through a Headless 360 MCP Server, which lets ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude run campaigns. Salesforce says Campaign Agent is generally available now.

title: Stagwell Launches "Stagwell AI," Its Unified Custom Portfolio of Agentic Marketing Solutions
summary: Stagwell has put its agentic marketing technology from Code and Theory, The Marketing Cloud and Stagwell Media Platform under one brand, Stagwell AI. It includes enterprise products such as Machine OS, The Targeting Machine and The Media Machine, plus a self-service offering for small and mid-sized businesses called NEW by Stagwell AI. Palantir and Adobe are technology partners.

title: LinkedIn's B2B Audiences Are Now Available On CTV Via Google DV360
summary: Advertisers can now buy LinkedIn CTV ads programmatically through Google's Display & Video 360 and target streaming TV by LinkedIn first-party professional data such as job title, company size, industry and seniority. It is US-only and enabled via LinkedIn or Google reps; inventory comes from Microsoft Monetize. DV360 is LinkedIn's fourth outside DSP after Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk and Microsoft Advertising. VistaPrint tested it and reported positive brand lift.

title: Cuttable Raises $20M In Series A Funding, Relaunches AI Ad Platform
summary: Melbourne startup Cuttable, whose AI turns product photos and videos into Meta and TikTok ads, raised a $20M Series A led by Airtree Ventures, with Square Peg, Rampersand and Glitch Capital participating. It relaunched its platform to recommend what a brand should run next using ad results, Shopify catalogue data and tools such as Klaviyo and Triple Whale. It works with 440+ ecommerce brands and will hire in Melbourne, New York and San Francisco.

title: Google Ads lets retailers multiply new customer values up to 5x
summary: Google Ads is taking percentage multipliers (1.1x to 5x) for new-customer value out of beta across Search, Shopping, Performance Max and Demand Gen in Google Ads and SA360, alongside three retention modes (Re-engagement, Loyalty, Retention-only) rolling out later in October. New vs. existing customers are identified using advertiser first-party lists such as Customer Match or remarketing lists with at least 1,000 active members.

title: Quantum Metric MCP Gives Enterprise AI Agents the Experience Context to Act on What Matters Most
summary: Quantum Metric made its MCP server generally available, giving any MCP-compatible agent 46 tools to query digital-experience data, summarize sessions, build funnels and run monitoring agents. It also announced Quantum Metric A2A, letting its Felix Agentic act as a peer agent, and Quantum Metric Artifacts for shareable investigation views. Royal Caribbean Group is a named customer, and Optimizely lists the server in its Opal connector directory.

title: Madhive Selects AdImpact to Bring Competitive Spend Data To Local Media
summary: Madhive will integrate AdImpact's competitive ad-spend data across broadcast, cable and streaming, covering 210 markets and 41,000 zip codes (54,000+ local CTV advertisers tracked), into its Maverick AI local intelligence layer, letting local sellers and buyers see market share by advertiser, network, station and streaming app. Announced 12 days before the November 3 midterms; no launch date, pricing or financial terms disclosed.
